title: The Peninsula Tokyo: A Palace View in the Middle of the City

turns.speaker: advisor
turns.name: Luxury Advisor
turns.text: The Peninsula Tokyo faces the Imperial Palace gardens and Hibiya Park. The thing to know: it's a city tower with a palace view, not a retreat.

turns.speaker: advisor
turns.name: Luxury Advisor
turns.text: Mostly. Direct entrance to Hibiya station, Ginza about three minutes on foot. Inside, more than 1,000 artworks by Japanese artists, and a vitality pool overlooking the palace gardens.

turns.speaker: traveler
turns.name: Candid Traveler
turns.text: And the house cars. Rolls-Royce Phantoms, plus custom MINIs for suite guests.

turns.speaker: advisor
turns.name: Luxury Advisor
turns.text: Dining's the other draw. Cantonese at Hei Fung Terrace, afternoon tea with live music, and Peter on the 24th floor, now Modern French. Great for food-focused couples and first-time Tokyo visitors.

turns.speaker: traveler
turns.name: Candid Traveler
turns.text: Business travelers too. And it's pet-friendly, with a dog menu.

turns.speaker: traveler
turns.name: Candid Traveler
turns.text: Worth knowing: older reviews calling Peter a steakhouse are out of date. And fly into Haneda; it's about 40 minutes by bus, Narita about 90.

turns.speaker: advisor
turns.name: Luxury Advisor
turns.text: Fair. And palace and park views depend on room category.

turns.speaker: traveler
turns.name: Candid Traveler
turns.text: Right. It's a dense business and shopping district, the pool's indoors, and your green space is the park across the street.

turns.speaker: advisor
turns.name: Luxury Advisor
turns.text: That's the thing. You're here for the city.

turns.speaker: traveler
turns.name: Candid Traveler
turns.text: Exactly. If you want Tokyo at your door and a palace view, it's right for you. Want a resort escape? Look elsewhere.

turns.speaker: advisor
turns.name: Luxury Advisor
turns.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, you get free breakfast for two daily, free Wi-Fi, a priority upgrade if available at check-in, a $100 hotel credit, among other perks.

short_version.best_for: Food-focused couples, shoppers and first-time Tokyo visitors
short_version.atmosphere: Art-filled city tower facing the Imperial Palace gardens
short_version.worth_knowing: Dense city-centre district; Haneda is far easier; views vary by room
